title: Turning thinking off on Claude Sonnet 5.5 fails with thinking type disabled, and computer_20251124 returns 400
symptoms: 400 error when sending thinking: {"type":"disabled"} to claude-sonnet-5-5
computer_20251124 tool rejected on Claude API or Google Cloud
advisor tool rejects Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, or Sonnet 5 as the advisor model
cause: Since the Claude Sonnet 5.5 launch on 2026-09-28, up-front thinking is turned off with thinking type between_tools instead of disabled, and only at high effort or below. The earlier computer_20251124 tool is not accepted on the Claude API and Google Cloud, and the advisor tool rejects some older models as advisors.
fix: Send thinking type between_tools with effort high or lower. Switch to the computer_toolset_20260801 toolset. Pick a supported advisor model.
affected: claude-sonnet-5-5, from 2026-09-28, migrating from Claude Sonnet 5
